environment.description: Express application deployed behind AWS API Gateway (REST API type) with a request validator attached to each method resource. The validator has 'validateRequestBody' set to true with a JSON Schema model that enforces a required 'x-csrf-nonce' field (type: string, minLength: 32, pattern: ^[a-f0-9]{32,64}$) at the top level of every POST request body. Requests that do not include this field or where it fails pattern validation receive a 400 response from the gateway before reaching the backend. The API Gateway integration uses VPC Link to a private ALB, so the Express app is not directly addressable. Additionally, the API Gateway resource policy restricts invoke access to requests originating from the application's registered CloudFront distribution via a condition on aws:Referer header matching the app domain.

config.integration: VPC Link to private ALB (app not publicly addressable)
config.resource_policy: Allow only when aws:Referer matches https://app.example.com/*
config.cloudfront_origin: API Gateway endpoint as origin with custom header forwarding
